name: Jina Reader MCP
tagline: Fetch any URL and get clean markdown back — perfect for RAG and search.
shortDescription: The official Jina Reader MCP server. Takes any URL and returns the content as clean markdown, stripped of ads, nav, and JavaScript. The cleanest way to feed web pages into an agent or RAG pipeline.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Jina Reader MCP server, by Jina AI. Exposes Jina's reader API as MCP tools: pass a URL, get back clean markdown. Works on any public URL (articles, docs, blog posts, PDFs). Used by many RAG pipelines for ingestion.

## Why we recommend it

If your agent needs to read web pages (for research, RAG, or content analysis), Jina Reader is the cleanest extraction library. Better than raw curl+cheerio because it handles JS-rendered pages, extracts the actual content (not nav/ads), and works on a huge range of sites. The MCP wrapper means your agent can call it directly.

## When to use it

- RAG ingestion: agent fetches and parses documentation pages
- Research tasks: agent reads multiple sources to answer a question
- Content analysis: agent extracts the main article from a news page
- Documentation lookup: agent pulls the relevant section from a docs site
installInstructions:
1. Get a free API key at https://jina.ai/
2. Set `JINA_API_KEY=jina_...`
3. `uvx mcp-jina-reader`

**Free tier:** 1M tokens/month for free. Enough for most personal/agent use.
